name: CoinMarketCap
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to monitoring by Scam Sniffer, the front end of CoinMarketCap has been compromised. Users are advised to remain vigilant. Following an investigation, CoinMarketCap confirmed that a total of 76 accounts were affected, with losses amounting to $21,624.47. The platform has pledged to fully reimburse the impacted users.
